prompt:
You are a hardware-debug illustrator. Draw ONE technical signal-flow diagram (dark background, light labels) explaining a RISC-V RTL failure.
Case: picorv32-fetch-misalign
Failing-trace sha256 (first 16 hex): 6df5b825f5a24a57
Verbatim diagnosis from the debug agent:
TRAP: fetch misalign addr low bits nonzero with tohost FAIL 0xdead because mem_la_addr low bits are 2'b10 instead of expected 2'b00 for word-aligned fetch. Root cause at picorv32.v:382 where mem_la_addr forces {next_pc[31:2]+mem_la_firstword_xfer,2'b10} for mem_do_prefetch/mem_do_rinst and {reg_op1[31:2],2'b10} for data. Every lookahead fetch therefore stays misaligned and never makes progress.
Diagram MUST show: the failing signal path named in the diagnosis, the wrong value vs the expected value, and the single RTL line to fix. Annotate the trace hash 6df5b825f5a24a57 in a corner as provenance. No decorative elements, no invented signals.
